newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-BASLER PUTS BAYERN TOP OF BUNDESLIGA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BASLER PUTS BAYERN TOP OF BUNDESLIGA.

text.p: Midfielder Mario Basler put Bayern Munich top of the Bundesliga on Saturday with both goals in their 2-1 win over bottom club Hansa Rostock.
Basler converted a penalty in 31st minute and blasted home a long range shot two minutes before the break.
The win allowed Bayern to leapfrog over previous leaders VfB Stuttgart, who play Duisburg on Sunday, and Bayer Leverkusen, who began the day in second place but lost 3-1 away to St Pauli.
Champions Borussia Dortmund moved ominously up to third with an impressive 4-0 win over Werder Bremen.

A goal from Swiss star Stephane Chapuisat and two from Heiko Herrlich put Dortmund in the driving seat before the break and Bremen's misery was completed by a second-half own goal from Heimo Pfeifenberger.
